ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Empire PowerShell Launch Parameters
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious powershell command line parameters used in Empire

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-NoP\\ \\-sta\\ \\-NonI\\ \\-W\\ Hidden\\ \\-Enc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-noP\\ \\-sta\\ \\-w\\ 1\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-NoP\\ \\-NonI\\ \\-W\\ Hidden\\ \\-enc\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-noP\\ \\-sta\\ \\-w\\ 1\\ \\-enc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-enc\\ \\ SQB.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-nop\\ \\-exec\\ bypass\\ \\-EncodedCommand\\ .*"))
